gbm_population_evidence.quote: High Grade Glioma (III or IV); Diffuse Midline Glioma (DMG); Glioblastoma (GBM)
Including but not limited to: IDH wild-type glioblastoma (GBM), IDH-mutant astrocytoma (Grade 3-4), IDH-mutant oligodendroglioma (Grade 3), etc.

candidate_evidence.quote: An Open-Label, Multicenter, Phase I Study of FZ-AD005 Antibody-Drug Conjugate in Patients With Recurrent/Refractory High-Grade Glioma (HGG)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must be in the maintenance treatment phase following new diagnosis and completion of standard first-line radiotherapy
Group B (Recurrent or progressive high-grade glioma): Recurrent or progressive high-grade glioma (WHO CNS5 Grade 3-4).

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To measure the drug profile for absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion for Total Antibody, Free DXd and FZ-AD005 in participants blood plasma

role_evidence.quote: Subjects will receive an intravenous infusion of FZ-AD005 until confirmed progression, unaccepted toxicity, or any criterion for withdrawal from the study.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational DLL3-directed antibody-drug conjugate with DXd (topoisomerase I inhibitor) payload

source_quote.quote: Patients must be able to provide tumor tissue samples (archived tumor tissue within 2 years \[maximum 5 years\] or fresh core needle biopsy specimen, if possible) for DLL3 testing, with positive assessment results;
Group A (Post-radiotherapy maintenance phase): Diffuse midline glioma (DMG), with H3 K27 alterated by CLIA-certified laboratory;

coder_notes: DLL3 positivity is an entry requirement for all patients and DLL3 is the target of the ADC (exclusion of prior anti-DLL3 therapy and DXd-payload ADCs supports this), so candidate-matched. H3 K27 alteration defines Group A (DMG cohort) only; groups are not registered arms (single registered arm 'FZ-AD005'), so arms left empty. IDH status appears only as diagnostic categories, not an entry requirement. Setting both: Group A post-radiotherapy maintenance after new diagnosis (DMG), Group B recurrent HGG including GBM. PK in plasma only.
